from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,os,signal
repo=Path('/Users/steventran/jobpipe')
src=repo/'core/job_salary_eligibility.py'; tst=repo/'tests/test_job_salary_eligibility.py'
head=subprocess.run(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=repo,capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout.strip()
remote=subprocess.run(['git','rev-parse','origin/main'],cwd=repo,capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout.strip()
if head!='da91aaf880e170b91ec94cd2ca7799edc1328037' or head!=remote:raise SystemExit('HEAD_ORIGIN_CHANGED')
for p in (src,tst):
 if subprocess.run(['git','status','--porcelain','--',p.relative_to(repo).as_posix()],cwd=repo,capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout.strip():raise SystemExit('TARGET_DIRTY')
print('STATUS_BEFORE',subprocess.run(['git','status','--short'],cwd=repo,text=True,capture_output=True,check=True).stdout)
with tst.open('a') as f:f.write("""
def test_unspecified_pay_period_must_not_be_assumed_annual():
    evidence = SalaryEvidence(85000, 95000, 'USD', 'BASE', 'https://example.org/job')
    assert evidence.pay_period == 'UNKNOWN'
    assert decide_salary(evidence, 100000) is SalaryDecision.NEEDS_BASE_EVIDENCE
""")
def run(args,limit):
 p=subprocess.Popen([str(repo/'.venv/bin/python'),'-m','pytest','-q','--maxfail=1']+args,cwd=repo,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True,start_new_session=True)
 try:o,e=p.communicate(timeout=limit)
 except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
  os.killpg(p.pid,signal.SIGTERM)
  try:o,e=p.communicate(timeout=8)
  except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:os.killpg(p.pid,signal.SIGKILL);o,e=p.communicate()
  print('TIMEOUT',args,o[-2000:]);raise SystemExit(124)
 print('TEST',args,'EXIT',p.returncode,o[-3500:],e[-300:])
 return p.returncode,o
red,out=run(['tests/test_job_salary_eligibility.py','-k','unspecified_pay_period_must_not_be_assumed_annual'],35)
if red==0 or '1 failed' not in out:raise SystemExit('NO_VALID_RED')
source=src.read_text()
assert source.count("pay_period: str = 'ANNUAL'")==1
src.write_text(source.replace("pay_period: str = 'ANNUAL'","pay_period: str = 'UNKNOWN'",1))
# Existing legacy tests intentionally express annual salary, so make their periods explicit.
text=tst.read_text()
for a,b in [
 ("SalaryEvidence(85000, 95000, 'USD', 'BASE', 'https://example.org/job')\n    assert decide_salary", "SalaryEvidence(85000, 95000, 'USD', 'BASE', 'https://example.org/job', pay_period='ANNUAL')\n    assert decide_salary"),
 ("SalaryEvidence(85000, 105000, 'USD', 'BASE', 'https://example.org/job')", "SalaryEvidence(85000, 105000, 'USD', 'BASE', 'https://example.org/job', pay_period='ANNUAL')")
 ]:
 if text.count(a)!=1:raise SystemExit('TEST_ANCHOR_CHANGED '+a[:35])
 text=text.replace(a,b,1)
tst.write_text(text)
for args,limit in [(['tests/test_job_salary_eligibility.py'],45),([],570)]:
 rc,_=run(args,limit)
 if rc:raise SystemExit('VALIDATION_FAILED')
subprocess.run(['git','add','--','core/job_salary_eligibility.py','tests/test_job_salary_eligibility.py'],cwd=repo,check=True)
subprocess.run(['git','commit','-m','fix: do not assume unqualified salary figures are annual'],cwd=repo,check=True)
subprocess.run(['git','push','origin','main'],cwd=repo,check=True,timeout=90)
print('VERIFIED_PUSH')
